summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the Notice of its Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for September 16, 2026. Agenda items include re-election of directors, ratification of auditors, and approval of a reverse share split at a ratio between 1-for-5 and 1-for-20 as determined by the board. The reverse split is an ordinary corporate governance matter, not a special-situation event such as a capital return or restructuring. No deal terms, premium, or special-situation mechanics are present. The filing is routine and deserves classification as None.
